runs.prompt: On 15 October 2026 the Philadelphia Eagles released a statement about quarterback Jalen Hurts. runs.answer: The Eagles' official statement (dated Oct 15, 2026) says: Hurts first requested calf treatment on Thursday, Oct 8, after being cleated in the Oct 4 Rams game; he practiced in full that week and was added to the practice report. A precautionary ultrasound after the team's flight to London revealed a "superficial blood clot"; team doctors and London doctors concluded he "could safely play" and recommended a follow-up ultrasound within 72 hours. He played without limitation, got treatment Monday–Tuesday, and practiced in full Wednesday. Then "a follow-up ultrasound revealed movement in the small blood clot," so "Jalen will be out for Sunday's game vs. the Panthers as we determine the appropriate course of treatment." Medical status: superficial/small blood clot that has now shown movement. The only timeline given is that he is ruled out for Sunday's Panthers game; the team gives no return date, saying only that his health and safety are the highest priority while it determines the course of treatment.
